name: Acolyte
desc: You have spent your life in service to a temple, learning its rites and rituals.

feature.name: Shelter of the Faithful
feature.desc: You and your companions can receive free healing and care at temples of your faith. You have a place to stay at such temples and can call on priests for non-hazardous assistance.

name: Charlatan
desc: You have always had a talent for making people believe what you want them to believe.
starting_equipment: Con tools (stoppered bottles, weighted dice, marked cards)

feature.name: False Identity
feature.desc: You have a second identity, including documentation, established contacts, and disguises. You can also forge documents, though not official seals of powerful entities.

name: Criminal
desc: You are an experienced criminal with a history of breaking the law.

feature.name: Criminal Contact
feature.desc: You have a reliable contact who acts as your liaison to a network of criminals. You can get messages to and from your contact over any distance.

name: Entertainer
desc: You thrive in front of an audience, knowing how to entrance, entertain, and inspire.

feature.name: By Popular Demand
feature.desc: You can always find a place to perform in exchange for free lodging and food. Your performance makes you something of a local figure wherever you go.

name: Folk Hero
desc: You come from a humble background but are destined for greater things, already seen as a hero by common folk.

feature.name: Rustic Hospitality
feature.desc: Common folk will shelter you from those who hunt you, though not at risk to themselves. They will give you a place to hide, rest, and recover.

name: Guild Artisan
desc: You are a member of an artisan's guild, skilled in a particular trade and linked to a network of fellow craftspeople.
starting_equipment: Letter of introduction from your guild

feature.name: Guild Membership
feature.desc: Your guild provides lodging and food, legal aid, and access to powerful guild members. In return, you pay dues of 5gp per month.

name: Hermit
desc: You lived in seclusion for a formative part of your life, sheltered from society in search of solitude and contemplation.

feature.name: Discovery
feature.desc: Your seclusion gave you access to a unique discovery — a great truth, a secret of the world, a location, or a power. Work with your DM to determine the nature of your discovery.

name: Noble
desc: You understand wealth, power, and privilege, having been born into a family of high social standing.

feature.name: Position of Privilege
feature.desc: People assume you have the right to be wherever you are. Common folk make way for you; other nobles treat you as a peer. You can get an audience with local nobles and officials.

name: Outlander
desc: You grew up in the wilds, far from civilization, and have learned to survive with few resources.
starting_equipment: Trophy from an animal you killed

feature.name: Wanderer
feature.desc: You have an excellent memory for maps and geography. You can always find food and fresh water for yourself and up to 5 others when in natural terrain.

name: Sage
desc: You spent years learning the lore of the multiverse, poring over manuscripts and memorizing what you learned.

feature.name: Researcher
feature.desc: When you don't know a piece of lore, you know where to find it — a library, a university, a sage. If the information exists and isn't secret, you can track it down.

name: Sailor
desc: You sailed on a seagoing vessel for years, picking up the skills of the trade along the way.

feature.name: Ship's Passage
feature.desc: You can secure free passage on sailing ships for yourself and companions. You might have to work during the voyage, and passage isn't guaranteed in times of war.

name: Soldier
desc: War has been your life for as long as you can remember, and you've fought for a lord, a nation, or a mercenary company.
starting_equipment: Deck of cards or dice set

feature.name: Military Rank
feature.desc: Soldiers loyal to your former military organization recognize your rank and defer to you. You can invoke your rank to commandeer horses, equipment, and hospitality from them.

name: Urchin
desc: You grew up on the streets, surviving by your wits and learning the ways of the city's underbelly.

feature.name: City Secrets
feature.desc: You know the secret patterns and flow of cities. You can find passages through urban areas that others would miss, moving twice the normal speed when not in combat.
